text:
maria_cs: :wave: Quick primrose private deploy update — running day0 smoke, hit three blockers that are preventing canaries from completing: 1) customer FW/NACL blocking egress to our audit/log forwarder, 2) KMS key policy doesn't include the service account principal we asked for, 3) billing flagged low initial usage (renewal risk signal). Posting specifics below and assigning owners.

aj_sre: can you paste the failed connection trace? which port/host is being blocked?

maria_cs: trace shows TCP RST to splunk-forwarder.redwood-internal.net:443 from the VPC nat. snippet: `connect to splunk-forwarder.redwood-internal.net:443: connection refused` — customer says outbound egress is locked to specific CIDRs.

noah_infra: they only opened these ranges: `10.0.0.0/8, 192.168.0.0/16`. Our forwarder IPs are in 34.102.18.0/24 and 34.102.19.0/24. We asked them to allow those but FW team says they need a request with justification.

aj_sre: ok, small ask — can we provide a minimal allowlist snippet they can drop in? example SG/NACL rule: ```
Inbound: none
Outbound:
  - Destination: 34.102.18.0/24, Protocol: TCP, Port: 443, Description: Splunk forwarder
  - Destination: 34.102.19.0/24, Protocol: TCP, Port: 443, Description: Splunk forwarder
```

lee_sec: KMS note — their key policy currently only allows principals from `aws:PrincipalOrgID` X. We requested the service account principal `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-logging` be added. Without that, our agent can't decrypt the envelope key for audit uploads. Minimal policy snippet to share: ```
{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-logging"},
  "Action": ["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
  "Resource": "*"
}
```

maria_cs: adding context for the FW ask: customer compliance team wants justification for each external CIDR. Suggested justification: `Outbound to Redwood audit/log endpoints for centralized security telemetry; TLS over 443; only to fixed egress ranges`. I pasted that into the ticket.

renee_billing: flagged renewal risk — saw usage is <10% of expected for week0. Not urgent yet but want a ramp plan to avoid sales outreach. Can CS propose a two-week activation plan?

amaria_cs: yes — proposed plan in ticket CS-4821: week1 smoke + integration, week2 seeded traffic (internal QA + 3x user segments). Will sync with customer PM today.

aj_sre: temporary mitigation for the audit pipeline: if customer won't open the CIDR, we can proxy logs via their Splunk Heavy Forwarder inside the VPC. That needs an IAM cross-account role grant and a short-lived token. Slightly more ops but avoids wide egress rules.

noah_infra: can implement proxy pattern. need a time window to push role and small SG change. ETA?: tomorrow 07:00-08:00 UTC maintenance window?

maria_cs: prefer to hold changes until we confirm with customer — they asked for changes during their maintenance window tomorrow 07:00-09:00 UTC. i'll confirm by EOD.

onboard-bot: Ticket created CS-4821 and assigned to queues: sec/infra/cs. SLA: 48h. Links: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/CS-4821

lee_sec: one more ask — customer audit retention settings currently point to S3 bucket `primrose-logs-prod` with public-blocks set to true; please ensure bucket policies deny `s3:PutObject` unless via the redwood-logging role. sample condition attached in the ticket.

maria_cs: thanks all — action items: (1) i'll confirm maintenance window with customer, (2) aj/noah to prepare proxy playbook if FW changes stall, (3) lee to share exact KMS policy language to hand to the customer's cloud security. i'll update CS-4821 after EOD. :thumbsup:
